$comment: Copy for the VISIBLE Services section (the interactive card deck) — distinct from services.json, which is the catalogue of individual services, and from servicesSeo.json, which is the hidden crawlable version. Editable content — safe for a CMS. Headings are split into parts because each part carries a different gradient; keep the trailing space on `headingLeadTrail` (it separates the two halves when they wrap onto one line). In `tabs.hint` the token {count} is replaced with the real number of categories at render time — keep it in any rewrite; `tabs.hintCompact` is the phone-width version and has no room for it.
